release_rule: Every system with required_for_live=true must be VERIFIED before TX-LIVE-0001.

systems.name: Domain registrar / root domain authority
systems.secret_location: Owner private emergency vault and registrar account
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Registrar account recovery plus domain-transfer procedure
systems.safe_shutdown: Preserve domain; do not transfer during an unresolved account-compromise incident
systems.replacement_path: Transfer domain to another registrar and repoint authoritative DNS
systems.verification_needed: Prove owner login, MFA recovery and domain-transfer authority without ChatGPT

systems.name: GitHub source control
systems.authority: Canonical source code, migrations, CI and technical documentation
systems.secret_location: GitHub account/recovery material in owner private emergency vault; no production secrets in repository
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Full git clone plus owner-controlled off-provider copy
systems.safe_shutdown: Freeze merges/deployments; production runtime can continue independently
systems.replacement_path: Push complete git history to another Git-compatible host
systems.verification_needed: Connected operator can push, but repository/organization admin recovery and off-provider clone still require proof

systems.name: Cloudflare runtime / DNS / D1 / R2 / Turnstile
systems.authority: Production application runtime, operational database, durable artifacts, DNS routes and abuse protection
systems.durable_data: D1 records and R2 transaction/statement/legal-evidence artifacts
systems.secret_location: Cloudflare Worker secret store; account recovery material in owner private emergency vault
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Documented D1 export/restore plus R2 copy/retrieval procedure and source-controlled Worker configuration
systems.safe_shutdown: Pause public/payment creation routes while preserving existing processor truth and durable records
systems.replacement_path: Deploy repository source to replacement compute/database/object storage and repoint DNS
systems.verification_needed: Create production account resources, prove owner recovery, D1 restore, R2 retrieval/hash verification, deployment and rollback

systems.name: Stripe platform / Connect processor adapter
systems.authority: Payment processing, connected-account processor facts, application fees and payout facts
systems.durable_data: Processor-native payment, fee, dispute, balance and payout records
systems.secret_location: Cloudflare Worker secret store for runtime keys; Stripe account recovery material in owner private emergency vault
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Stripe dashboard/API exports plus Builtegrity normalized transaction history
systems.safe_shutdown: Stop creation of new Stripe-routed protected payments; never fabricate processor state
systems.replacement_path: Preserve historical Stripe facts and route future transactions through a new processor adapter
systems.verification_needed: Prove owner platform recovery, test/live separation, key rotation, webhook control and emergency payment-route pause

systems.name: Clerk identity provider
systems.durable_data: Provider identity records; Builtegrity authorization remains in D1
systems.secret_location: Cloudflare configuration/secrets where applicable; Clerk recovery material in owner private emergency vault
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Provider-supported identity export/API plus documented reauthentication/reset strategy
systems.safe_shutdown: Pause privileged user operations; never bypass tenant authorization
systems.replacement_path: Replace identity-verification adapter while retaining D1 merchant/partner roles and relationships
systems.verification_needed: Create application and prove owner recovery, identity migration path and controlled provider replacement

systems.name: Resend outbound/inbound email adapter
systems.authority: Outbound transaction/statement/alert/legal-intake delivery and verified inbound legal-notice receipt
systems.durable_data: Delivery/receiving-provider metadata; canonical statements, transaction truth and preserved legal evidence remain in Builtegrity
systems.secret_location: Cloudflare Worker secret store for API/webhook secrets; Resend recovery material in owner private emergency vault
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Provider logs/events plus canonical Builtegrity statement, delivery and legal-intake audit records
systems.safe_shutdown: Stop outbound submission while preserving queued/durable statement, alert and legal-incident state; inbound provider storage remains an emergency recovery source
systems.replacement_path: Swap email adapter and reconfigure domain authentication/receiving webhook
systems.verification_needed: Account/domain exists but production DNS verification, dedicated API keys, legal receiving subdomain/webhook and owner-recovery test remain incomplete

systems.name: Standing counsel / registered agent / legal-response program
systems.authority: Privileged legal classification, deadline verification, litigation/regulatory response, evidence-hold clearance and identification of decisions requiring corporate authority
systems.durable_data: Engagement records, legal incident audit trail, counsel references, preservation holds, provider callback receipts and matter references
systems.secret_location: Counsel/registered-agent account recovery and callback secrets in the owner private emergency vault and Cloudflare Worker secret store as applicable
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Direct law-firm/registered-agent recovery plus Builtegrity legal incident/evidence export and documented replacement-counsel cutover
systems.safe_shutdown: Preserve evidence, keep holds active, send no substantive response, block PILOT/LIVE activity if the response program is unavailable
systems.replacement_path: Engage replacement qualified counsel, rotate callback/intake secrets, update provider record and resume only after legal-response readiness returns to READY
systems.verification_needed: Execute active engagement, confirm privileged standing-counsel intake, test registered-agent forwarding, test signed counsel callback, and complete a legal incident drill without requiring owner message relay

systems.name: Google Workspace business communications
systems.secret_location: Google account recovery and MFA material in owner private emergency vault
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Workspace admin recovery plus appropriate mailbox/data export path
systems.safe_shutdown: Maintain monitored owner mailbox and preserve domain mail routing
systems.replacement_path: Migrate mail/data and update domain MX/authentication records
systems.verification_needed: Monitored Builtegrity mailbox is reachable; super-admin recovery and export path still require proof

systems.name: Business banking / accounting authority
systems.authority: Company funds, settlement destination and accounting/tax records
systems.durable_data: Bank statements, accounting ledger and financial records
systems.secret_location: Owner private emergency vault; never GitHub, Drive documents or ChatGPT
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Direct financial-institution/accounting-provider recovery and data export
systems.safe_shutdown: Freeze risky transfers/processor changes while preserving reconciliation records
systems.replacement_path: Move banking/accounting providers through controlled reconciliation and documented cutover
systems.verification_needed: Prove direct owner recovery and identify the accounts used for live platform funds and accounting

systems.name: Owner private emergency vault
systems.authority: Independent recovery material for every critical account
systems.durable_data: Credential inventory, MFA recovery codes, recovery contacts and emergency account metadata
systems.secret_location: Private owner-controlled vault plus independently protected recovery copy
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Owner-controlled vault recovery procedure tested without ChatGPT
systems.safe_shutdown: If vault integrity is uncertain, rotate affected provider credentials before relying on stored material
systems.replacement_path: Migrate vault contents to another secure owner-controlled credential manager using documented inventory
systems.verification_needed: Create and test the private vault; never store its secret values in this repository

systems.name: ChatGPT / Work / connectors / AI automations
systems.authority: Convenience, engineering assistance, monitoring and operational acceleration only
systems.durable_data: No unique canonical production authority permitted
systems.secret_location: No production secret may exist only in AI context
systems.export_or_recovery_path: Production continues without AI; canonical code/data remain in owner-controlled systems
systems.safe_shutdown: Disconnect AI/connectors without interrupting product runtime
systems.replacement_path: Human operator, engineer, alternate automation or no AI at all
